experiment: School Memory Book Cutter Validation v1

common_gates: Hero must have a commercial task

timeline.commercial_job: Identify the School Memories Album from its readable cover.
Open the cover into a readable Preschool spread.
Show profile and school-detail prompts on an early-year page.
timeline.new_information: Early pages structure personal and school details.

timeline.commercial_job: Hold the 1st Grade picture and self-drawing spaces until readable.
timeline.new_information: Pages include picture and drawing spaces.

timeline.commercial_job: Turn from 3rd Grade to 4th Grade without truncating the action.
timeline.new_information: The sequence continues into later grade designs.

timeline.commercial_job: Confirm a readable 9th Grade page and its later-school prompts.
Summarize the tour with page thickness followed by a clean cover.
Establish a readable early-school starting point.
Resolve the hook with a readable later-grade contrast in the same product.
timeline.new_information: One album connects early school with a later grade.

timeline.commercial_job: Name the object after the multi-year value has been posed.
timeline.new_information: It is a School Memories Album.

timeline.commercial_job: Prove the structure with one intact 1st-to-2nd Grade page turn.
timeline.new_information: Grade progression is built into separated sections.

timeline.commercial_job: Show readable later-grade profile, subject and activity fields.
timeline.new_information: Each year can use a consistent school snapshot structure.

timeline.commercial_job: Show both school-picture and self-drawing spaces without implying completed use.
timeline.new_information: The structure accepts different visual memory types.

timeline.commercial_job: Add favorites and future-looking reflection prompts as a non-duplicate state.
timeline.new_information: The book records more than a basic profile.

timeline.commercial_job: Use one intact edge flip to connect many varied year designs without fabricating a family reaction.
timeline.new_information: Many changing school-year snapshots can live together.

timeline.commercial_job: Resolve the evidence ladder into page volume followed by the complete album cover.
timeline.new_information: The previously shown year sections belong to one substantial album.
